name: Cunning-Woman of the Peat
languages: Common and any three languages, Sylvan

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The cunning-woman makes three Arcane Burst attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Trespasser's Curse.

Actions.name: Arcane Burst
Actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The cunning-woman casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** *Detect Magic*, *Light*, *Mage Armor*, *Mage Hand*, *Prestidigitation*
- **2/Day Each:** *Fireball*, *Invisibility*
- **1/Day Each:** *Cone of Cold*, *Fly*

Actions.name: Name-Binding Hex (2/Day)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition and its Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.
Actions.gmQuote: a marsh witch who curses trespassers

Actions.name: Trespasser's Curse
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn.

Reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
Reactions.text: The cunning-woman casts *Counterspell* or *Shield* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Bonus Actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The cunning-woman casts *Misty Step*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

lore: A village cunning-woman who bound her own name into the marsh peat to keep the fen from drowning her, she now tolls trespassers for the debt the wetlands are owed.
